name: Hoshiya Kei
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend.

Even though they were aware of each other's feelings, they became separated before they could develop their relationship. Eventually, she married another man whom she met in college. She currently works at a dating agency.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1219676]Getchu[/url]]
